prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1449; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over the course of twelve visits, care followed a typical conservative pathway that included manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Range of motion was limited on initial examination, with paraspinal muscle tenderness noted on palpation, while neurological screening and reflex testing remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned, with discharge planned once the patient reached expected recovery milestones. Note that two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service are currently under review for accuracy. Prognosis is good with continued self-management.
